class.description: Declared class. The verifier (scripts/test-infra/verify_live_evidence.sh) RECLASSIFIES a LIVE claim to UNIT when the answering identity is a registered double, mismatched or missing.

skip_reason.description: Closed set (11.4.69). Required when verdict is SKIP.

fingerprint.description: Read FROM THE TARGET at run time (version endpoint, binary hash, image id).

source.description: Where the fingerprint was read from, e.g. target.

answering.description: What actually answered. null only for SKIP.

script_path.description: Interpreter-hosted servers: the script that answers (required with script_sha256 when exe is python, node, java, ...).

runtime_hint.description: Interpreter runtime detected from /proc/<pid>/maps (libpython, libnode, libjvm, ...) when the exe name is not a known interpreter.

env_checked.description: true when the recorder read /proc/<pid>/environ for the closed key set of the interpreter option table (env_keys + env_prefixes). Required true for every process/socket answering, interpreter or native (else UNIT env_unrecorded); not needed for container. false/absent/non-boolean = unreadable (e.g. a service of another user), older recorder or hand-written record: never clean.

env_injected.description: Names of the keys from that closed set whose value was NON-EMPTY in the answering process (e.g. NODE_OPTIONS, LD_PRELOAD, BASH_FUNC_foo%%). Non-empty => UNIT interpreter_env_injection for interpreters; the loader keys (env_loader: LD_PRELOAD, LD_AUDIT, LD_LIBRARY_PATH) => UNIT loader_env_injection for every other process kind. A non-array value is never clean.

expected.description: The real artifact the claim names: exe_sha256 (process) or image_digest (container). Mismatch reclassifies to UNIT.

script_sha256.description: Required for interpreter-hosted servers; must equal answering.script_sha256 and, when the fingerprint is a sha256, the fingerprint.

n.description: 11.4.50 asks for N>=3 for a PASS.

identical.description: Must be true for PASS/FAIL records.

signature.description: sha256 over the canonical per-run verdict.

resolve_error.description: Listener unresolved or ambiguous (several pids hold the LISTEN socket): the verifier reclassifies UNIT.
